title: Add policy simulator, KMS consent orchestrator, and RBAC safelist scanner
author: Priya Desai
description: Motivation: provide an operator-friendly way to validate RBAC v2 and KMS region constraints against real traffic patterns before rolling policy changes live, and to centralize consent gating for KMS operations. This PR ships three coordinated pieces: 1) a lightweight policy-simulator service that can ingest a sample of request events and evaluate RBAC v2 + KMS region rules to surface likely denials or silent fallbacks; 2) a KMS Consent Orchestrator that standardizes consent checks and short-circuiting for CMK operations (used by private deployments and Dedicated) and emits structured audit events; 3) an RBAC Safelist Scanner that runs periodically to detect overly permissive role bindings and suggests scoped replacements. Changes: added new services/policy-simulator (service, CLI, API), services/kms-consent-orchestrator (engine, adapters for AWS/GCP/Azure, tests), pkg/rbac/safelist_scanner.go and ruleset definitions, small infra updates (terraform module to grant simulator read-only event stream access), and docs/security/policy-simulator.md with runbook and examples. Checklist: - [x] Design doc: Linear ENG-4321 linked - [x] Unit tests for simulator rule evaluation - [x] Integration tests for orchestrator w/ mock KMS providers - [x] End-to-end smoke in staging - [x] Docs and runbook added - [x] Security review and threat model completed Key behaviors and notes: the simulator runs in dry-run mode by default and emits a per-request decision with reasons (missing role, region mismatch, consent-missing). The orchestrator exposes a consent API that returns a stable consent token used by downstream KMS adapters; tokens are short-lived and audited. The safelist scanner runs weekly and produces suggested remediations (JSON output) that can be consumed by infra teams. Backwards compatibility: all host-facing APIs are opt-in; no runtime changes to existing KMS flows unless the orchestrator is explicitly enabled in config. Rollout plan: feature flag behind release/tenant toggles, start with internal tenants, run simulator on 1% of traffic for two weeks, then increase to 25% while monitoring audit delta. Related: SUP-1123 (customer reported inconsistent region errors), ENG-4210 (observability hook for policy decisions). Risks & mitigations: increased audit volume — added batched audit forwarder and sampling config; potential latency in KMS path — orchestrator runs async consent validation for non-critical ops and provides fallback. Impact: improves compliance posture (clearer region pinning failures), reduces human error during RBAC updates, and enables safe rollout of stricter KMS scoping. Please see docs/security/policy-simulator.md and design/ENG-4321 for full details.

Jasper Wu: Nit: move ruleset JSON to pkg/rbac/rules/defaults.json for reuse. Author: moved and added shared loader and tests.
